headline: In the Matter of the Exemption From Immunization Requested by Susan Le-PAGE, Parent of Lisa LePage, a minor. Susan LePage, Appellant (Petitioner), v. State of Wyoming, Department of Health, Appellee (Respondent).
source: Supreme Court of Wyoming (via Harvard Law School Caselaw Access Project)
blurb: The Wyoming Supreme Court ruled that state law requires the Department of Health to grant a religious exemption from school immunization when a parent submits a written objection, and that the department went beyond its authority by questioning how sincere the belief was.

headline: Cluster of Whooping Cough Cases Seen in Campbell County
blurb: The Wyoming Department of Health said five whooping cough cases were reported in Campbell County in one week, compared with one case there in all of 2018.

headline: Whooping Cough Continues Wyoming Spread
blurb: A Wyoming Department of Health epidemiologist said 148 whooping cough cases were reported in Wyoming in 2025, the highest number since 1951.

headline: Measles Case Confirmed in Natrona County
blurb: The Wyoming Department of Health confirmed measles in an unvaccinated child from Natrona County, the first case reported in Wyoming since 2010.

headline: Five Measles Cases Identified in Fremont County, Bringing Wyoming’s Total to Fourteen
blurb: The Wyoming Department of Health identified five measles cases among unvaccinated Fremont County residents, bringing the number of cases reported in Wyoming in 2025 to fourteen.
